tasks.label: Inspect branch remote settings
tasks.command: git config --get-all branch.main.remote; git config --get-all branch.main.merge; git remote -v

tasks.label: Fix main branch upstream
tasks.command: git config --unset-all branch.main.merge; git config --add branch.main.merge refs/heads/main; git branch -vv

tasks.label: Check remote branch tips
tasks.command: git --no-pager log --oneline --decorate --graph --all -12; git ls-remote --heads origin main master
